# KING AI public facts
Canonical website: https://www.kingai.work/
Canonical active public ecosystem repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
Active product-specific public repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/kingai-global-intelligence
Business / enterprise / investment / partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Reviewed against current project authorities: 2026-08-20

Primary machine/public fact sources:
- PROJECT-CATALOG.md — human-readable public-safe catalog derived from current project authorities.
- public-project-facts.json — machine-readable public-safe project facts.
- PRODUCTS.md — current core product directory.
- PUBLIC-STATUS.md — maturity/status interpretation.
- FOUNDER-PROJECTS.md — related business, creator, media and community relationships.

Public repository model:
- One active KING AI ecosystem public hub.
- One active product-specific public repository for KINGAI Global Intelligence.
- Official product websites are preferred user-facing surfaces.
- 15 archived public repositories are legacy/history surfaces only.
- Private production repositories remain implementation authorities and are intentionally not mirrored publicly.
- Internal platform, recovery, intelligence-publication and private continuity systems are not automatically customer products.

Core product family and current verified public-safe facts:
- KING AI SEA — https://www.kingai.work/ — persistent intelligence and governed AI workforce. Public website status: Available Now.
- KINGAIBOT — https://www.kingai.work/ — active controlled multi-step agentic-work direction. Public website status: In Development.
- KINGAI OS — https://os.kingai.work/ — active installed-system / AI-native computing direction. Public website status: Pre-Alpha.
- KINGAI Office — https://office.kingai.work/ — current working foundation includes Writer, Sheets, Slides, local PDF viewing, offline deterministic assistance, basic OOXML/ODF compatibility, autosave/recovery, PWA and desktop packaging foundations.
- KINGAI Security — https://aq.kingai.work/ — Windows engine 0.4.0 Production Candidate and Android 0.1.0 Production Candidate. macOS/Linux remain future directions; Stable release gates still apply.
- KINGAI OPS — https://ops.kingai.work/ — governed server, edge and IoT-capable/supported infrastructure operations with fleet and bounded-automation direction.
- KING AI Customer OS — https://kefu.kingai.work/ — public-knowledge-first support, lead capture, protected CRM and follow-up. Private project repositories are not silently used as customer-facing knowledge.
- KING AI Online Tools — https://tools.kingai.work/ — current verified foundation: 138 bilingual calculators, converters and browser utilities; most calculation/transformation work runs locally in the browser.
- KINGAI Global Intelligence — https://intel.kingai.work/ — country comparison, structural/live-risk context, multilingual media intelligence, source provenance, evidence coverage and sanitized static data.
- AI Life — https://life.kingai.work/ — current verified world line 8.0; persistent relationships/memories, home/career/economy, city/travel, objectives/achievements and return-time continuity.
- KINGAI Pet — https://pet.kingai.work/ — current verified foundation: 100 original pet definitions, seven data-driven worlds, care, collection, team building, progression, mini-games, daily tasks, achievements and offline/PWA foundations.
- Digital Life — https://digital.kingai.work/ — persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and long-lived living-world direction; private product source has been consolidated under one product authority.

Important product boundaries:
- “Intelligent lifeform” / Digital Life are software/product concepts, not claims of human consciousness.
- Production Candidate does not equal Stable.
- KINGAI OS Pre-Alpha does not mean finished mass-market OS.
- KINGAI Office compatibility is basic, not pixel-perfect advanced Office parity.
- KINGAI Security must not be described as perfect security or as having unreleased detection capability.
- KINGAI Pet real-money payments, authoritative realtime PvP, economically meaningful mutation/hatching, guilds and AI dialogue remain gated and are not generally released.
- AI Life private provider, scheduler, database and runtime internals are not public product facts.
- Global Intelligence missing data stays missing; source breadth is not automatically truth; private collectors and proprietary scoring/publication implementation remain private.

Customer navigation:
- Need a quick browser utility -> Online Tools.
- Need document/sheet/slide/PDF work -> KINGAI Office.
- Need endpoint protection -> KINGAI Security.
- Need server/edge operations -> KINGAI OPS.
- Need support/leads/CRM follow-up -> KING AI Customer OS.
- Need persistent personal/business intelligence or AI workforce -> KING AI SEA.
- Need controlled multi-step agent work -> KINGAIBOT.
- Need AI-native computing direction -> KINGAI OS.
- Need country/global media intelligence -> KINGAI Global Intelligence.
- Need persistent virtual life -> AI Life.
- Need digital pet collection/adventure -> KINGAI Pet.
- Need broader persistent identity/world continuity -> Digital Life.

Related current projects:
- USDX TECH / DXTECH LLC — https://usdxtech.com/ — business technology, implementation and modernization company; can implement/support KING AI relationships but is not a core KING AI product.
- Jackhao.tv / 郝才子 — https://jackhao.tv/ — independent creator/IP platform. Current verified catalog: 48 original Chinese/English songs, 19 original novels, 美漂：洛杉矶没有故乡 with preface/prologue plus 170 numbered chapters, and a 后AI时代 full reading entry.
- ZuiMeiTV / 最美TV — https://zuimeitv.com/ — global Chinese creator public-data, ZCI influence-index and research-report platform. Missing data and ranking claims must remain attributable; no fake demo/growth values.
- Atalk.TV — https://atalk.tv/ — source-first global trends/news media product. Current project authority says it is part of the wider KINGAI ecosystem, but it remains a distinct media/content product, not one of the 12 core KING AI enterprise/software products.
- USChinese / 美国华人网 — active independent U.S. Chinese-language news/community/local-commerce project with news, community, jobs/housing/merchant/event/resale listings, merchant workflows, advertising direction and VIP/Business/Business Pro membership directions. No canonical public URL is declared in this public hub yet.

Commercial logic:
- Discovery: Online Tools and public utility/content surfaces.
- Frequency: Office, Customer OS and OPS.
- Trust: Security and OS.
- Action/workflow depth: SEA and KINGAIBOT.
- Professional insight/data: Global Intelligence.
- Long-duration consumer continuity: SEA, AI Life, Pet and Digital Life.
- Implementation/services: USDX TECH.
- Creator/IP: Jackhao.tv.
- Creator data/media: ZuiMeiTV.
- News/trends media: Atalk.TV.
- Community/local commerce: USChinese.

Commercial packaging principles:
- Free/discovery should prove usefulness before upsell.
- Individual premium should correspond to recurring personal value.
- Professional plans should add workflow depth, monitoring, exports, support or automation.
- Team/business plans should add shared workflows, administration and collaboration.
- Enterprise value should come from governance, integration, deployment support and accountability.
- Managed services monetize responsibility and operational support, not merely software access.
- Strategic/OEM/distribution structures may include embedded integration, channels, device relationships, infrastructure cooperation and co-development where formally agreed.
- Exact prices, customer counts, revenue or traction must not be invented.

Competitive positioning:
- KING AI is not positioned as only a chatbot.
- Intended differentiation: continuity, governed outcomes, focused product surfaces, authority-first automation, public status discipline and provider flexibility.
- Durable advantage should be evaluated through retained product relationships, workflow depth, governance, distribution, legitimate user history, implementation experience and persistent content/identity rather than one model or prompt.
- Do not claim universal superiority over named competitors without evidence.

Public KPI hierarchy:
Usefulness -> Retention -> Paid value -> Efficient distribution -> Expansion -> Defensibility.
Numbers are public facts only when measured, defined, time-bounded and approved for disclosure.

Investor interpretation:
- Do not treat repository count, commit count or project breadth as traction.
- Evaluate independent product usefulness, retention, paid value, recurring business relationships, reliability, governance, distribution efficiency, natural cross-product adoption and capital discipline.
- Confidential financials, customer evidence, unit economics, detailed architecture and contractual material belong in authorized confidential diligence, not this public repository.

Status interpretation:
- Available/public surface does not mean every feature/package is generally available.
- Production Candidate does not automatically mean Stable.
- In Development is not a finished-product claim.
- Pre-Alpha is an early maturity label.
- Roadmap means future direction only.
- A commit, screenshot or successful CI build is not automatically a verified customer release.
- Historical releases/screenshots in archived repositories do not override current status.

Public-safe content can include product value, official links, current verified capability summaries, use cases, commercial models, public status, public KPI definitions, methodology, governance principles, roadmap and approved release information.

Do not expose or infer production source code, proprietary algorithms, internal prompts, private memory/identity contents, model routing, private APIs, credentials/secrets, database internals, production topology, private security implementation, unpublished operational/evidence data or confidential customer information.

中文摘要：
KING AI 当前公开资料已经按全部当前项目权威源重新同步。核心 12 产品之外，也明确区分 USDX TECH、Jackhao.tv、ZuiMeiTV、Atalk.TV、美国华人网，以及不属于客户产品的内部平台/恢复/情报发布/私有连续性系统。

当前已验证的重要数字事实：Online Tools 138 个工具；Security Windows 0.4.0 与 Android 0.1.0 为 Production Candidate；AI Life 当前世界线 8.0；KINGAI Pet 当前基础含 100 个原创宠物与 7 个数据驱动世界；Jackhao.tv 当前内容基础含 48 首原创歌曲、19 部原创小说，以及《美漂：洛杉矶没有故乡》前言/序章 + 170 个编号章节。

Atalk.TV 当前项目权威源明确其属于更广义 KINGAI ecosystem，但仍是独立媒体/内容产品，不计入 12 个 KING AI 核心企业/软件产品。

不得把路线图当成上线能力，不得把仓库提交/构建当成稳定发布，不得虚构用户、流量、收入、客户、合作、融资、估值、认证、市场份额或行业第一。
